assumptions_metadata.task_description: Compute season standings and playoff outcomes for an IPL analytics dashboard by aggregating validated match results.

assumptions.assumption: team1 and team2 must be different teams.
If result != 'no result', winner must be either team1 or team2.
If result = 'no result', winner is null.
If result = 'runs', result_margin is an integer >= 1 and <= 200.
If result = 'wickets', result_margin is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.
If result in ('tie','no result'), result_margin is null.
toss_winner must be either team1 or team2.
toss_decision must be one of {'bat','field'}.
At least 55% of rows have toss_decision = 'field'.
target_overs must be > 0 and <= 20.
If method = 'D/L', target_overs < 20.
If method is null and result != 'no result', target_overs = 20.
target_runs must be between 1 and 300 inclusive.
At least 99% of rows have non-null target_runs and target_overs.
date must be parseable in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
season equals the 4-digit year extracted from date.
Exactly one match per season has match_type = 'Final'.
At least 90% of matches have match_type = 'League'.
super_over must be one of {'Y','N'}.
If super_over = 'Y', result = 'tie'.
If super_over = 'N', result != 'tie'.
For non-null city, the city name (case-insensitive) must appear in venue.
At least 95% of rows have non-null city.
Each venue maps to a single city across the dataset (no venue appears with multiple cities).

result.code:
import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def compute_standings_and_playoffs(input_path: str, output_path: str) -> None:
    os.makedirs(output_path, exist_ok=True)
    src = os.path.join(input_path, 'previous_data.csv')
    df = pd.read_csv(src)

    # Normalize and coerce types used in downstream logic
    df['result'] = df['result'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['toss_decision'] = df['toss_decision'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['super_over'] = df['super_over'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
    df['venue'] = df['venue'].astype(str)
    df['city'] = df['city'].astype(str).where(~df['city'].isna(), other=np.nan)

    for col in ['result_margin', 'target_runs', 'target_overs']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

    # Guard checks used by season parsing and grouping
    parsed_date = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], errors='coerce', format='%Y-%m-%d')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert parsed_date.notna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['season'].astype(str) == parsed_date.dt.year.astype(str)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Team pairing integrity before any winner-based aggregation
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Winner consistency with teams and no-result semantics
    non_no_result = df['result'] != 'no result'
    winner_is_valid = df['winner'].isna() | ((df['winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['winner'] == df['team2']))
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert winner_is_valid[non_no_result].all()
    assert df.loc[df['result'] == 'no result', 'winner'].isna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Toss constraints used to compute toss-based metrics
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['toss_decision'].isin(['bat', 'field']).all()
    assert ((df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])).all()
    field_ratio = (df['toss_decision'] == 'field').mean()
    assert field_ratio >= 0.55
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Target and method constraints used for dominance normalization
    method_is_dl = df['method'].astype(str) == 'D/L'
    method_is_null = df['method'].isna() | (df['method'].astype(str).isin(['nan', 'NaN']))

    # ASSERTION_START
    non_null_overs = df['target_overs'].notna()
    assert df.loc[non_null_overs, 'target_overs'].gt(0).all() and df.loc[non_null_overs, 'target_overs'].le(20).all()
    assert (df.loc[method_is_dl, 'target_overs'] < 20).all()
    mask_mnull_played = method_is_null & (df['result'] != 'no result')
    assert (df.loc[mask_mnull_played, 'target_overs'] == 20).all()
    non_null_runs = df['target_runs'].notna()
    assert df.loc[non_null_runs, 'target_runs'].between(1, 300).all()
    enough_non_null = (df['target_runs'].notna() & df['target_overs'].notna()).mean()
    assert enough_non_null >= 0.99
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Result margin semantics used for dominance_score
    is_runs = df['result'] == 'runs'
    is_wkts = df['result'] == 'wickets'
    is_tie_or_nr = df['result'].isin(['tie', 'no result'])

    # ASSERTION_START
    runs_rm = df.loc[is_runs, 'result_margin'].dropna()
    wickets_rm = df.loc[is_wkts, 'result_margin'].dropna()
    assert ((runs_rm % 1 == 0) & runs_rm.between(1, 200)).all()
    assert ((wickets_rm % 1 == 0) & wickets_rm.between(1, 10)).all()
    assert df.loc[is_tie_or_nr, 'result_margin'].isna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Super over semantics used to interpret tie metrics
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['super_over'].isin(['Y', 'N']).all()
    assert (df.loc[df['super_over'] == 'Y', 'result'] == 'tie').all()
    assert (df.loc[df['super_over'] == 'N', 'result'] != 'tie').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Venue-city mapping used to impute any missing city values and aggregate location stats
    non_null_city = df['city'].notna()
    # ASSERTION_START
    venue_contains_city = df.loc[non_null_city].apply(lambda r: str(r['city']).lower() in str(r['venue']).lower(), axis=1)
    assert venue_contains_city.all()
    assert non_null_city.mean() >= 0.95
    vc_nunique = df.groupby('venue', dropna=False)['city'].nunique(dropna=True)
    assert (vc_nunique <= 1).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Ensure exactly one Final per season before champion derivation
    # ASSERTION_START
    finals_per_season = df[df['match_type'] == 'Final'].groupby('season')['id'].nunique()
    all_seasons = df['season'].astype(str).unique()
    missing_or_multiple = [s for s in all_seasons if s not in finals_per_season.index.astype(str).tolist() or finals_per_season.loc[finals_per_season.index.astype(str) == s].values[0] != 1]
    assert len(missing_or_multiple) == 0
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Ensure dataset is mostly league to justify league-based standings
    # ASSERTION_START
    league_ratio = (df['match_type'] == 'League').mean()
    assert league_ratio >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Build a venue->city map and fill missing cities if any
    venue_city_map = df.loc[df['city'].notna(), ['venue', 'city']].drop_duplicates().groupby('venue').agg({'city': 'first'})['city'].to_dict()
    df['city_imputed'] = df['city']
    df.loc[df['city_imputed'].isna(), 'city_imputed'] = df.loc[df['city_imputed'].isna(), 'venue'].map(venue_city_map)

    # League matches for standings
    league_df = df[df['match_type'] == 'League'].copy()

    # Compute per-match dominance score (winner positive, loser negative), normalized by overs
    dom_base = np.where(
        league_df['result'] == 'runs',
        league_df['result_margin'].fillna(0),
        np.where(league_df['result'] == 'wickets', league_df['result_margin'].fillna(0) * 10, 0)
    )
    overs_norm = 20 / league_df['target_overs'].replace(0, np.nan)
    dom_score_match = dom_base * overs_norm.fillna(1.0)

    # Prepare long form for team-level aggregation
    cols_needed = ['id', 'season', 'team1', 'team2', 'winner', 'result', 'super_over']
    if 'target_overs' in league_df.columns:
        cols_needed.append('target_overs')
    if 'result_margin' in league_df.columns:
        cols_needed.append('result_margin')

    lsmall = league_df[cols_needed].copy()
    l1 = lsmall.rename(columns={'team1': 'team', 'team2': 'opponent'})
    l2 = lsmall.rename(columns={'team2': 'team', 'team1': 'opponent'})
    long_league = pd.concat([l1, l2], ignore_index=True)

    # Attach dominance score per match and convert to team-sign
    dom_map = dict(zip(league_df['id'], dom_score_match))
    long_league['dom_match'] = long_league['id'].map(dom_map).fillna(0.0)
    long_league['win'] = (long_league['winner'] == long_league['team']) & (long_league['result'] != 'no result')
    long_league['no_result'] = long_league['result'] == 'no result'

    long_league['dom_team'] = np.where(long_league['win'], long_league['dom_match'], np.where(long_league['no_result'], 0.0, -long_league['dom_match']))
    long_league['points'] = np.where(long_league['win'], 2, 0) + np.where(long_league['no_result'], 1, 0)

    standings = (
        long_league.groupby(['season', 'team']).agg(
            matches=('id', 'count'),
            wins=('win', 'sum'),
            no_results=('no_result', 'sum'),
            points=('points', 'sum'),
            dominance_score=('dom_team', 'sum'),
            super_over_matches=(lambda x: (long_league.loc[x.index, 'super_over'] == 'Y').sum())
        ).reset_index()
    )
    standings['losses'] = standings['matches'] - standings['wins'] - standings['no_results']

    standings = standings.sort_values(['season', 'points', 'wins', 'dominance_score'], ascending=[True, False, False, False])
    standings['rank'] = standings.groupby('season').cumcount() + 1

    # Playoff outcomes and champions
    playoffs = df[df['match_type'] != 'League'].copy()
    playoffs_out = playoffs[['season', 'id', 'date', 'match_type', 'team1', 'team2', 'winner', 'result']].sort_values(['season', 'date', 'id'])

    finals = playoffs[playoffs['match_type'] == 'Final']
    champions = finals[['season', 'winner']].rename(columns={'winner': 'champion'})

    # Write outputs
    standings.to_csv(os.path.join(output_path, 'season_standings.csv'), index=False)
    playoffs_out.to_csv(os.path.join(output_path, 'playoff_outcomes.csv'), index=False)
    champions.to_csv(os.path.join(output_path, 'season_champions.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    compute_standings_and_playoffs(args.input, args.output)

If method is null and result != 'no result', target_overs = 20.
target_runs must be between 1 and 300 inclusive.
At least 99% of rows have non-null target_runs and target_overs.
date must be parseable in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
season equals the 4-digit year extracted from date.
Exactly one match per season has match_type = 'Final'.
At least 90% of matches have match_type = 'League'.

If super_over = 'Y', result = 'tie'.
If super_over = 'N', result != 'tie'.

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def compute_standings_and_playoffs(input_path: str, output_path: str) -> None:
    os.makedirs(output_path, exist_ok=True)
    src = os.path.join(input_path, 'previous_data.csv')
    df = pd.read_csv(src)

    # Normalize and coerce types used in downstream logic
    df['result'] = df['result'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['toss_decision'] = df['toss_decision'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['super_over'] = df['super_over'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
    df['venue'] = df['venue'].astype(str)
    df['city'] = df['city'].astype(str).where(~df['city'].isna(), other=np.nan)

    for col in ['result_margin', 'target_runs', 'target_overs']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

    # Guard checks used by season parsing and grouping
    parsed_date = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], errors='coerce', format='%Y-%m-%d')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert parsed_date.notna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['season'].astype(str) == parsed_date.dt.year.astype(str)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Team pairing integrity before any winner-based aggregation
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Winner consistency with teams and no-result semantics
    non_no_result = df['result'] != 'no result'
    winner_is_valid = df['winner'].isna() | ((df['winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['winner'] == df['team2']))
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert winner_is_valid[non_no_result].all()
    assert df.loc[df['result'] == 'no result', 'winner'].isna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Toss constraints used to compute toss-based metrics
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['toss_decision'].isin(['bat', 'field']).all()
    assert ((df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])).all()
    field_ratio = (df['toss_decision'] == 'field').mean()
    assert field_ratio >= 0.55
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Target and method constraints used for dominance normalization
    method_is_dl = df['method'].astype(str) == 'D/L'
    method_is_null = df['method'].isna() | (df['method'].astype(str).isin(['nan', 'NaN']))

    # ASSERTION_START
    non_null_overs = df['target_overs'].notna()
    assert df.loc[non_null_overs, 'target_overs'].gt(0).all() and df.loc[non_null_overs, 'target_overs'].le(20).all()
    assert (df.loc[method_is_dl, 'target_overs'] < 20).all()
    mask_mnull_played = method_is_null & (df['result'] != 'no result')
    assert (df.loc[mask_mnull_played, 'target_overs'] == 20).all()
    non_null_runs = df['target_runs'].notna()
    assert df.loc[non_null_runs, 'target_runs'].between(1, 300).all()
    enough_non_null = (df['target_runs'].notna() & df['target_overs'].notna()).mean()
    assert enough_non_null >= 0.99
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Result margin semantics used for dominance_score
    is_runs = df['result'] == 'runs'
    is_wkts = df['result'] == 'wickets'
    is_tie_or_nr = df['result'].isin(['tie', 'no result'])

    # ASSERTION_START
    runs_rm = df.loc[is_runs, 'result_margin'].dropna()
    wickets_rm = df.loc[is_wkts, 'result_margin'].dropna()
    assert ((runs_rm % 1 == 0) & runs_rm.between(1, 200)).all()
    assert ((wickets_rm % 1 == 0) & wickets_rm.between(1, 10)).all()
    assert df.loc[is_tie_or_nr, 'result_margin'].isna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Super over semantics used to interpret tie metrics
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['super_over'].isin(['Y', 'N']).all()
    assert (df.loc[df['super_over'] == 'Y', 'result'] == 'tie').all()
    assert (df.loc[df['super_over'] == 'N', 'result'] != 'tie').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Venue-city mapping used to impute any missing city values and aggregate location stats
    non_null_city = df['city'].notna()
    # ASSERTION_START
    venue_contains_city = df.loc[non_null_city].apply(lambda r: str(r['city']).lower() in str(r['venue']).lower(), axis=1)
    assert venue_contains_city.all()
    assert non_null_city.mean() >= 0.95
    vc_nunique = df.groupby('venue', dropna=False)['city'].nunique(dropna=True)
    assert (vc_nunique <= 1).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Ensure exactly one Final per season before champion derivation
    # ASSERTION_START
    finals_per_season = df[df['match_type'] == 'Final'].groupby('season')['id'].nunique()
    all_seasons = df['season'].astype(str).unique()
    missing_or_multiple = [s for s in all_seasons if s not in finals_per_season.index.astype(str).tolist() or finals_per_season.loc[finals_per_season.index.astype(str) == s].values[0] != 1]
    assert len(missing_or_multiple) == 0
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Ensure dataset is mostly league to justify league-based standings
    # ASSERTION_START
    league_ratio = (df['match_type'] == 'League').mean()
    assert league_ratio >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Build a venue->city map and fill missing cities if any
    venue_city_map = df.loc[df['city'].notna(), ['venue', 'city']].drop_duplicates().groupby('venue').agg({'city': 'first'})['city'].to_dict()
    df['city_imputed'] = df['city']
    df.loc[df['city_imputed'].isna(), 'city_imputed'] = df.loc[df['city_imputed'].isna(), 'venue'].map(venue_city_map)

    # League matches for standings
    league_df = df[df['match_type'] == 'League'].copy()

    # Compute per-match dominance score (winner positive, loser negative), normalized by overs
    dom_base = np.where(
        league_df['result'] == 'runs',
        league_df['result_margin'].fillna(0),
        np.where(league_df['result'] == 'wickets', league_df['result_margin'].fillna(0) * 10, 0)
    )
    overs_norm = 20 / league_df['target_overs'].replace(0, np.nan)
    dom_score_match = dom_base * overs_norm.fillna(1.0)

    # Prepare long form for team-level aggregation
    cols_needed = ['id', 'season', 'team1', 'team2', 'winner', 'result', 'super_over']
    if 'target_overs' in league_df.columns:
        cols_needed.append('target_overs')
    if 'result_margin' in league_df.columns:
        cols_needed.append('result_margin')

    lsmall = league_df[cols_needed].copy()
    l1 = lsmall.rename(columns={'team1': 'team', 'team2': 'opponent'})
    l2 = lsmall.rename(columns={'team2': 'team', 'team1': 'opponent'})
    long_league = pd.concat([l1, l2], ignore_index=True)

    # Attach dominance score per match and convert to team-sign
    dom_map = dict(zip(league_df['id'], dom_score_match))
    long_league['dom_match'] = long_league['id'].map(dom_map).fillna(0.0)
    long_league['win'] = (long_league['winner'] == long_league['team']) & (long_league['result'] != 'no result')
    long_league['no_result'] = long_league['result'] == 'no result'

    long_league['dom_team'] = np.where(long_league['win'], long_league['dom_match'], np.where(long_league['no_result'], 0.0, -long_league['dom_match']))
    long_league['points'] = np.where(long_league['win'], 2, 0) + np.where(long_league['no_result'], 1, 0)

    standings = (
        long_league.groupby(['season', 'team']).agg(
            matches=('id', 'count'),
            wins=('win', 'sum'),
            no_results=('no_result', 'sum'),
            points=('points', 'sum'),
            dominance_score=('dom_team', 'sum'),
            super_over_matches=(lambda x: (long_league.loc[x.index, 'super_over'] == 'Y').sum())
        ).reset_index()
    )
    standings['losses'] = standings['matches'] - standings['wins'] - standings['no_results']

    standings = standings.sort_values(['season', 'points', 'wins', 'dominance_score'], ascending=[True, False, False, False])
    standings['rank'] = standings.groupby('season').cumcount() + 1

    # Playoff outcomes and champions
    playoffs = df[df['match_type'] != 'League'].copy()
    playoffs_out = playoffs[['season', 'id', 'date', 'match_type', 'team1', 'team2', 'winner', 'result']].sort_values(['season', 'date', 'id'])

    finals = playoffs[playoffs['match_type'] == 'Final']
    champions = finals[['season', 'winner']].rename(columns={'winner': 'champion'})

    # Write outputs
    standings.to_csv(os.path.join(output_path, 'season_standings.csv'), index=False)
    playoffs_out.to_csv(os.path.join(output_path, 'playoff_outcomes.csv'), index=False)
    champions.to_csv(os.path.join(output_path, 'season_champions.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    compute_standings_and_playoffs(args.input, args.output)
